cohort: A cohort of 954 pregnant women in their third trimester, without pre-existing hypertension or diabetes, recruited from University of Michigan prenatal clinics.
finding: Chronic frequent-loud snoring is associated with an increased hazard ratio for earlier delivery compared to pre-pregnancy non-snorers.
gest_age: Participants were in their third trimester; deliveries before 38 weeks' gestation were an outcome.
